pain.title: Built for a region that global apps still treat as an afterthought.
pain.lede: Most finance tools assume English, dollars, and a Western view of money. The Arab world deserves better — and so does your relationship with wealth.

cells.title: English‑first by default
cells.desc: Arabic support is bolted on, translations are awkward, and RTL layouts break.

cells.title: No MENA banks or currencies
cells.desc: EGP, SAR, and AED are missing or treated as exotic. Manual entry becomes the only option.

cells.title: Zakat & Halal ignored
cells.desc: No Nisab logic. No Sharia‑aware screening. The values that shape your money are invisible.

cells.title: Generic, not guidance
cells.desc: Charts everywhere — but no coach who understands your context, your goals, your faith.

preview.title: The dashboard, the way you’d actually use it.
preview.lede: Charts, coach, Zakat, and goals — designed to feel calm, not crowded. Switch between four currencies. Read it right‑to‑left when you want.
preview.userMsg: How much can I save toward Hajj this year?
preview.botMsg: At your current rate, ~SAR 14,400. Trim dining by 20% and you’d reach 18,000 — enough to cover travel.

diff.title: Side by side, the difference is unmistakable.
diff.lede: Western budgeting apps weren’t built for Riyadh, Cairo, or Dubai. Local fintech apps weren’t built around guidance. Tharwa is the only one that’s both.

security.title: A finance product is only as good as the trust behind it.
security.lede: We’re building Tharwa with the same care a serious bank would expect — and the transparency users actually deserve.

cards.title: Secure authentication
cards.desc: Industry‑standard authentication, encrypted sessions, and optional biometric unlock on supported devices. Your access stays yours.

cards.title: Privacy‑first data handling
cards.desc: Financial data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We don’t sell your data, and you can export or delete everything at any time.

cards.title: Clear AI disclaimer
cards.desc: Tharwa Coach offers educational guidance, not guaranteed investment advice. Every suggestion is explained — and reversible.

cards.title: Regulated open banking
cards.desc: Future bank integrations will go through regulated open‑banking providers across MENA — never through screen‑scraping or password sharing.

security.disclaimer: Tharwa provides educational financial guidance and Halal awareness — it is not a substitute for professional investment, tax, or Sharia advice. Always consult a qualified specialist for material decisions.
